title: Source copy confirmation request v1
description: POST /api/v1/recordings/{recordingId}/source-copy-confirmation body (active staff only). Names the exact sealed inventory the staff member reviewed: the seal digest (sa-cjson-v1 over the normalized file inventory), the SHA-256 of the source_manifest OBJECT (a different identity) and the sealed file count. It carries no owner or staff identity: the server derives the owner from the recording and the actor from the session. The server streams and hashes every sealed original before it records the confirmation.
